result_tail: (slow everywhere, zero errors, health green). Three parallel triage lenses converged on the same config marker; a competing "recent restart caused it" hypothesis was tested and invalidated on timing (the first request right after the last restart was fast; the slowdown only started once the chaos marker landed, seconds later). An adversarial judge flagged the first cut of the hypothesis as inconclusive on wording ("fixed 1500ms" didn't match the observed spread), so I ran 5 more targeted probes to confirm the injection is jittered and capped, not fixed — a second judge pass then validated it.
